common_voice.selection: Nine fixed complete test clips selected by housing/rent vocabulary before inference. Selection constants are in fetch-clips.py. They are narratives rather than positive rental search requests.
common_voice.speaker_identifiers: Nine distinct hashed Common Voice client IDs, not independently verified physical speaker identities.
common_voice.reference: Independent dataset sentence field; no expected transcript is passed to the recognizer. No manual listening/transcription certification is claimed.

discovery_failures: Hugging Face dataset viewer filter returned HTTP500 authentication-service errors for both candidate corpus mirrors. Direct pinned public files were used instead.
Initial local discovery print used a string as a language mapping and raised TypeError after writing candidate metadata. The selector was corrected; it did not run ASR.
Initial bounded tar preview ended in ReadError at the deliberately incomplete range. Header iteration was bounded and the final range extractor checks tar checksums and exact member names.
